notes: Runs the repo's hierarchical clustering (PROC CLUSTER, Ward + PROC TREE dendrogram) and K-means clustering (PROC FASTCLUS, 3 clusters) on SpeedControl/Confidence/TheoryTest, then validates cluster separation with PROC GLM. Original read DriversKumelemeOrneklem from an SPSS .sav sample; this bundle builds an equivalent 40-row dataset in-line, sampled from the repo's own DriversLicenseData.csv. The three closing PROC GLM steps referenced DriversKumelemeOrneklem (which has no cluster column) in the original; retargeted to clust, the PROC FASTCLUS OUT= dataset that actually carries the cluster assignment, since that is the only dataset the GLM class/model statement could resolve against.
